content.value: A half-wave rectifier circuit employing an SCR is adjusted to have a gate-current of 1 mA. The (08) forward breakdown of SCR is adjusted 100 V for $1 _ { p } = 1 m \Lambda$ , If a sinusoidal voltage of 200 V peak is applied then find (i) firing angle, (ii) conduction angle. (iii) average output voltage, (i) average current for load resistance of 200 Ω, and (v) power output. Assume the holding current is zero.
